name: fraser-coho-workshop
title: Workshop demonstration: NuSEDS Fraser Coho — KNB Test Node
description: Teaching derivative of the Open Canada NuSEDS Fraser and BC Interior workbook: 173 Coho records from analysis years 2023-2024, retaining 14 source columns. Population-year pairs are not unique; retain waterbody and source record context. Working interpretations are pending scientific review by Bruno and Tom.

resources.name: escapement

fields.name: POP_ID
fields.title: POP_ID
fields.description: Identifier of the NuSEDS population referenced by this source record. It repeats across years and sometimes within one year.

fields.name: POPULATION
fields.title: POPULATION
fields.description: Source population name. The official dictionary describes a legacy composite of stream name, subdistrict, species and run type; retain the full label without reparsing it into asserted facts.

fields.name: AREA
fields.title: AREA
fields.description: NuSEDS subdistrict code. The official dictionary says subdistricts can differ from statistical areas, especially in the Fraser; do not relabel this field PFMA.

fields.name: WATERBODY
fields.title: WATERBODY
fields.description: Source name of the waterbody or portion bounding the population as represented on the source estimate document (SEN). It need not be a unique waterbody identifier.

fields.name: ANALYSIS_YR
fields.title: ANALYSIS_YR
fields.description: Year for which the estimate is reported. The official dictionary states that contributing surveys can continue into the next calendar year.

fields.name: SPECIES
fields.title: SPECIES
fields.description: Source species designation for the fish represented by the record; all values in this selected slice are Coho.

fields.name: RUN_TYPE
fields.title: RUN_TYPE
fields.description: Source run-type category. Preserve the supplied code or label; this slice contains 1, FALL and blanks.

fields.name: NATURAL_ADULT_SPAWNERS
fields.title: NATURAL_ADULT_SPAWNERS
fields.description: Reported estimate for mature spawners excluding jacks, under the source field NATURAL_ADULT_SPAWNERS. The official definition does not establish a natural-origin restriction; preserve that question rather than asserting it.

fields.name: ESTIMATE_METHOD
fields.title: ESTIMATE_METHOD
fields.description: Source label for the method used to derive the estimate. Interpret each label using its own definition; some entries in the official dictionary have no substantive definition.

fields.name: ESTIMATE_CLASSIFICATION
fields.title: ESTIMATE_CLASSIFICATION
fields.description: Source category describing the estimate and its accuracy/precision classification. NO SURVEY THIS YEAR means the stream was not inspected for that species that year according to the official dictionary.

fields.name: ESTIMATE_STAGE
fields.title: ESTIMATE_STAGE
fields.description: Source publication/readiness stage of the SEN estimate. All rows in this slice are FINAL; this source status does not approve our workshop interpretation or publication.

fields.name: START_DTT
fields.title: START_DTT
fields.description: Date stream inspections began for this season's estimate, following the official dictionary. The derivation converts source dates to ISO representation.

fields.name: END_DTT
fields.title: END_DTT
fields.description: Date stream inspections ended for this season's estimate, following the official dictionary. Keep separate from the estimate year.

fields.name: WATERSHED_CDE
fields.title: WATERSHED_CDE
fields.description: Source hierarchical provincial watershed code. Preserve the complete text, separators and zeroes; the official dictionary distinguishes this legacy code from FWA_Watershed_CDE.

resources.title: Escapement
resources.description: A NuSEDS source estimate record with population identifier, waterbody, analysis year and reported estimation context. POP_ID plus ANALYSIS_YR is not a unique record key.
